summary: The prepared base reproduced the issue-specific unsafe strategy selection: DeepSeek-V4 non-EP TBO returned eligible for attention TP4. The exact candidate adds the narrow requested gate, its regression passes, and an independent 11-case topology/path truth table found no counterexample within the original contract. The candidate preserves non-EP attention-TP1 and EP TBO and routes only unsupported non-EP attention-TP>1 through the synchronous fallback.

tests.what_was_measured: Imported /job/repo/python/sglang/srt/models/deepseek_v4.py at the recorded base and observed non-EP attn_tp_size=4, attn_dp_size=4 return True instead of the required False, reproducing the original unsafe strategy selection.
At exact candidate commit, 5 tests and 2 subtests passed, including the candidate's affected topology and preservation cases.
Rejected non-EP attention TP2, TP4, and TP8/DP2; preserved non-EP TP1 and EP TP4; preserved PP, CP, mode, feature, batch, and child eligibility gates.
Candidate source and regression test compile successfully.

gpu_execution.evidence: One AMD Instinct MI350X gfx950 GPU was visible, but the issue requires two hosts and 16 GPUs plus unavailable DeepSeek-V4-Pro-NVFP4 weights. Architecture was inspected only; no GPU execution is claimed as fix evidence.

remaining_limitations: No TP16/DP4 or TP16/DP2 multi-node serving A/B was possible with one GPU.
DeepSeek-V4-Pro-NVFP4 weights were unavailable, so full-model numerical output was not validated.
The regression verifies the actual TBO strategy-selection defect and synchronous fallback selection; it does not execute the corrupt full-TP collective.
No native source changed, so a native rebuild was not applicable.
